## Technical guidance and applicability (when relevant)

For decisions involving external platform, library, dependency, or tooling behavior, link authoritative documentation and its applicable versions. Distinguish **Documented** behavior from **Verified** repository results and any **Experimental** investigation of remaining uncertainty. Explain justified deviations and their tradeoffs. Refer to the evidence recorded above rather than duplicating commands and status. Omit this section for routine changes.

## Standards, templates, and security

- [ ] Applicable SOLID, TDD, dependency-boundary, and documentation policies are respected.
- [ ] Standards have one authoritative definition and clear applicability.
- [ ] No unimplemented template feature is presented as available.
- [ ] Any new tools, dependencies, licenses, and GitHub Actions permissions are reviewed.
- [ ] New scripts, if any, are locally executable and tested for meaningful behavior.
- [ ] No unrelated implementation or speculative placeholder configuration was introduced.

## Owner review

- [ ] Owner completed a second-pass review of the exact PR candidate and remaining risks.
- [ ] Applicable required checks passed on the candidate SHA, or the absence of automated checks is disclosed.
- [ ] Explicit owner authorization received before squash merge.

Merging does not authorize a tag, release, package publication, or template distribution. Those decisions require separate approval.
